open_items: Wire artifact-update CLI and planner to the same preview/normalization path in the scheduled authoring step.
Apply full Change Plan folding, metadata advancement, profile/lifecycle validation and transaction-bound live preconditions in later steps.
Proposal planning must include both revision and hash; this authoring input API accepts either and checks both when supplied.
Full supported Python matrix is evaluated by CI; local selected tests are not complete suite evidence.
18.e prepares native authoring values; built-in public CLI, authenticated control decisions, live locked preimages, request receipts and transactional publication retain their later M18 gates.

oracle.expected: Ordered complete plan retained; content edits advance both revisions once and reset draft while preserving ineffective historical reviews.
oracle.requirement_contract: Eine `update`-Operation MUSS einen RFC-6902-kompatiblen JSON Patch verwenden.
oracle.scope: Pure RFC-6902 value execution and guarded artifact candidates. No live storage reads, full Change Plan folding, metadata advancement, lifecycle approval, CLI command or publication. Native 18.e authoring and read-only target/history integration; no public writer or full workflow claim.

preconditions: Owned JSON values or a field-valid explicitly supplied artifact plus an update with an expected revision and/or canonical hash.
Complete native Proposal with changes, full replacement ChangePlan, explicit expected physical revision, actor/time and common request policy; small native model for target/history integration.
steps: Apply real RFC-6902 operations in order on an isolated value snapshot.
Compile ordered set/unset inputs without implicit parent creation or type conversion.
Check supplied target, revision/hash and controlled fields before returning a field-valid candidate; ensure original values are unchanged.
Prepare the four ordered authoring actions and reset changed open Proposals to draft with one physical/content revision.
Recompute the native target and requalify preserved synthetic review history; old approvals lose effect on actual content change.
